results.reply:
Self Assessment is a system used by HMRC to collect Income Tax. If you're self-employed, a partner in a partnership, or have untaxed income, you must file a Self Assessment tax return, usually once a year. The tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April, and you typically need to submit your return by 31 January following the end of the tax year if filing online, or by 31 October if filing on paper.

The return details your income, expenses, and any tax owed. It's important to keep accurate records throughout the year to ensure your return is correct. If you have any more questions about it, feel free to ask!
